newsitem.title: UK: UK shares end higher, budget gets initial welcome.
newsitem.headline: UK shares end higher, budget gets initial welcome.

text.p: UK shares closed higher on Wednesday as the equity market gave an initial welcome to the tax plans and economic forecasts in the early part of Chancellor Gordon Brown's budget.
The FTSE 100 index closed 23.1 points higher at 4,751.4, after being up just 5.5 points as the speech began at 1447 GMT. Gainers were in a near two-to-one majority.

After weeks of speculation about the first budget under a Labour government since 1978, the market welcomed Brown's surprise two percentage point cut in corporation tax and his forecast of low inflation and falling government borrowing.
